newsitem.title: CHINA: Daewoo Securities sets $50 mln Asia fund.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Securities sets $50 mln Asia fund.

text.p: Korea's biggest securities company Daewoo Securities Co said on Tuesday it was setting up a $50 million open-ended fund to invest in Asian stocks.
The Asia Access 2000 Fund is South Korea's first open-ended fund to have three sub-funds, focused on China, South Korea and Japan respectively, a company official said on Tuesday.
Daewoo expect the $50 million fund to be subscribed by September 10 and each sub-fund will receive at least $10 million, she added.
Crosby, one consultant to the fund, expects a 20 percent annual rate of profit from investing in Chinese stocks by the end of 1997, she said but gave no more details.
